tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Power of Attorney executed by the Bidder in favor of the Principal Officer or duly Authorized Representative, certifying him / her as an authorized signatory for the purpose of this Tender.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Furnishing of the Power of Attorney

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Registration Certificate issued under the Companies Act 1956 / 2003 (Certificate of Incorporation)/Registration with Commercial Tax Department.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The Bidder / OEM should be in business related to Supply of IT Hardware in India for at least 03 years as on 31.03.2026

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have a local presence and existence for a period of at least 3 years and experience in providing Supply of IT Hardware or similar services to Central / State Government/ I n s t i t u t i o n s or P u b l i c sector undertakings/Private Sectors

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of Incorporation / Registration with Commercial Tax Department

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should submit copy of PAN and GST in the name of firm/individual

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of PAN and GST registration certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should submit copy of Income Tax Returns (ITR) filed for preceding three financial year (2023-24 to 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of Income Tax Returns (ITR)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have more than INR.5 Crores average annual turnover during last three financial years (i.e., 2023-24 to 2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Turn over Certificate from the Chartered Accountant must be submitted with UDIN

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder must have completed at least 1 project worth minimum of INR 1.0 Crores for the Supply of IT Hardware or similar in any Central / State Government/ Institutions/Public sector undertakings or private sector.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- A Copy of Work Order and Client Completion / Performance and satisfactory reports for each of the projects undertaken to be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should not be debarred by any procurement entity in Central Government / State Government and its Departments for indulging in corrupt or fraudulent practices or for indulging in unfair trade practices for any reasons whatsoever at the time of bidding.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- A declaration by the authorized representative of the bidding agency to be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Any bidder from a country that shares a land border with India excluding countries to which the Government of India has extended lines of credit or in which the Government of India is engaged in development projects (as listed on the website of the Ministry of External Affairs) hereinafter called Restricted Countries should be eligible to participate in this RFP, only if the bidder is registered with the Registration Committee constituted by the Department f o r Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
The bidder should have a positive net worth for latest financial year (2025-26)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate from CA with UDIN

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should be authorized partner of the OEM products proposed.Bidder should have an office in Karnataka or else should give an undertaking that an office should be established if found successful in bidding

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- OEM Authorization form and undertaking for office establishment if office already not established in Karnataka.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Enclose Compliance statement with product brochures and specification etc and specify the make,model and version quoted against each items

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Compliance Excel statement of Pre Evaluation and technical specifications

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should fill and submit all Sections given in the RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Consortium bids are allowed with one more vendor/agency.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Consortium bidders should submit relevant documentary proof.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should fill and submit all Annexures given in the RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Fill and Submit Annexure I,II,III and IV I in the given format
